newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Newspaper robbed in Albanian capital.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper robbed in Albanian capital.

text.p: Gunmen robbed the office of an Albanian daily newspaper early on Tuesday.
Fatos Baxhaku, editor-in-chief of daily Gazeta Shqiptare, told Reuters three people stole money after threatening a security guard with an automatic rifle.
Baxhaku said the intruders did not touch the editorial office, which suggested the motive was straightforward theft.
But he said the paper has received a series of telephone threats. "Two weeks ago there was a bomb threat and almost every day we have had threatening telephone calls," he said.

Albania's newspapers have returned to regular publication in the run-up to snap elections on June 29, after a period of curbs linked to a state of emergency in force since early March, when widespread rioting and unrest gripped the country.
Amid the misrule following the collapse of fraudulent investment schemes, many businesses in the country are relying on private guards for security.
